recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18415 unless the work group separately reopens the broader representation-section decision made under FHIR-18414.
issue_request: FHIR-18415 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and asked to fix the Element XML simple-type example because the prose said a string property named "name" would be represented, while the example showed a status/code-style element.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to merge d925f27f. In that merge, side commit 1786bb3857 changed source/element.html from "a string property named \"name\"" to "a code property named \"status\"", matching the surrounding XML example. The adjacent commit titled GF#18415 only removed a blank line, so the effective content fix was carried by the merge rather than by a cleanly labeled per-issue commit.
additional_context: The current build no longer uses source/element.html. source/fhir.ini maps the Element type page to source/types.html, and later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-18414 removed the redundant XML/JSON Representation of Elements and Primitive Types sections from source/types.html in commit 7c6b930880. The authoritative primitive XML guidance now lives on xml.html and datatypes.html, where examples consistently show primitive values as XML value attributes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The stale "string property named name" example is absent from the active source, the current Element page no longer carries the redundant representation section, and the remaining XML primitive examples are already internally consistent.
